parameter_sampling_policy.notes: When current-loop joint_parameter_prior has positive reward evidence for the exact, coarse, scalar, or global theory family, common cosmological/scalar parameters are seeded from those joint vectors before coefficients are recomputed for the current operator set. Baseline samples draw raw coefficients from the broad coefficient prior. Non-EH curvature correction coefficients in weak/moderate/active_probe modes are sampled from a target effective size relative to the EH term using lambda_power and scalar field factors. EH R is fixed.

rationale: Cold-start proposal generated from token-level Grammar Masker and current-loop memory only. No historical solver_result, top-10 plot, or old best-fit parameter was used.

replay_debug.note: Debug replay of a previously accepted good theory using the current sampler; not cold-start discovery.
